_about: Limits for scripts/ci/footprint-check.sh (EDGE-LOWMEM-1). server_bytes and cli_bytes: release build (CGO_ENABLED=0 -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w'), limit = value measured on 2026-10-22 + 10%. idle_rss_kib: peak RSS of the secure-baseline SQLite server after 30 s idle, MAX of 3 runs, limit = measured + 25%; null = no baseline measured on that platform yet (the check skips it with a message, or fails under --require-rss). Refresh with `scripts/ci/footprint-check.sh --print`. These are tripwires for accidental growth, not targets: when growth is intended, raise the limit in the PR that causes it and say why.
